concepts.quote: Use point(0.5, 0.5), or call setXscale(0, 512) and setYscale(0, 512) first and then (256, 256) is the middle.
concepts.why: The answer sees that (256, 256) falls outside the default unit square, so the scale was never set, and it gives two correct fixes: draw in unit coordinates, or set the scales to 0..512 first, which puts (256, 256) at the centre.
The answer says nothing about the double type.
The answer says nothing about function plotting.
